title: Rural Business Development Grants in Michigan
overview: The purpose of the program is to promote economic development and job creation projects through the awarding of grant funds to eligible entities. Eligible applicants include public bodies, government entities, Indian Tribes, and nonprofit entities primarily serving rural areas. For-profit entities, individuals, and individual businesses are not eligible. Grant money must be used for projects that benefit rural areas or towns outside the urbanized periphery of any city with a population of 50,000 or more. Funds can be used for Opportunity grants or Enterprise grants, supporting activities like training, technical assistance, land acquisition, construction, revolving loan funds, distance learning, and community economic development. Applications are accepted through USDA Rural Development's local or state offices and are evaluated based on evidence of job creation, non-federal funding committed, economic need, consistency with local priorities, and grantee experience.
